column1: # Mark orders: marks in stored order (w warning, b background, u use), then ok (the pack loads) or no (the whole pack is refused).
w w b b u u
# Name pairs: two plants, each as common name, latin name, then any aliases, separated by a bar. ok means both plants load, no means the whole pack is refused.
# The text {zwsp} stands for one zero width space character in the reader's test, so this file holds only plain ASCII.
# A name that is only a part of another plant's longer name loads today and both plants are drawn when both are asked for. Accepted for now.
# A zero width character inside a word splits it, so the two names differ and both plants load.
# A name with no letter or digit is refused.
